title: Controlling Anger upon the Guidance of the Prophet ﷺ
summary: The Prophet ﷺ taught, when anger arises: seeking refuge in Allah, silence, changing one’s posture, and wudu. Teach your child that anger is natural, but it has tools. Be a model in your own calmness first.
try_this: This week: Teach your child one step to take when angry (a deep breath or sitting down), and apply it yourself in front of them.
reflection_prompts: How does your child express their anger?
Did the new tool help them?
